findings.title: Supply the V3 publication artifacts before claiming curation closure
findings.body: The snapshot contains all 120 dependency files with matching bundle pins, but has no top-level `manifest.json`, `safe_to_promote_paths.json`, or `public_curation_closure.json`. Consequently, the verification procedure in PUBLIC_CURATION.md cannot run, and the three restored companions have no explicit V3 publication allowlist entries. `source_snapshot_v1.json` supplies hashes but does not establish publication eligibility; the prior V2 artifacts cannot substitute for V3 bindings. Include the V3 publication artifacts and verify their closure, or explicitly mark closure as pending instead of claiming it is included.

overall_explanation: The serializer classification and newline-inclusive 32 MiB caps appear correct, and all 120 copied dependency members match their frozen pins. However, the required V3 manifest/allowlist/public-copy closure is absent despite the handoff claiming it is included. Inspection was read-only; tests were not executed.
